name: fs_read_file
description: This tool allows you to read the complete contents of a file from the local filesystem as UTF-8 text. Use this tool whenever the user asks what is in a file or when you need file contents to complete a task. Access is restricted to the directories the server was launched with; attempts to read outside the sandbox fail with a permission error. Very large files are truncated at 2 MB and the response notes the truncation so you never mistake a prefix for the whole file.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to read, e.g. /workspace/app/config.yaml.

encoding.description: Text encoding used to decode the file bytes.
